items.english: Choose one member of the auditors in audit-roster by any permitted selection method; the instruction does not require random or equal-probability selection.

every member must have equal probability
the first member must be chosen
items.answer: any selection method is allowed; equal probability is not required

items.english: Randomly draw one member from the auditors in audit-roster, giving every member equal probability of selection.
